# Vocabulary: feedback

Dominant feedback loop polarity the mechanic creates in play.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `reinforcing` | Reinforcing (positive) | Success compounds success or failure compounds failure (snowball, death spiral). |
| `balancing` | Balancing (negative) | Deviation triggers correction toward an equilibrium. |
| `both` | Both | Contains reinforcing and balancing loops whose dominance shifts with state. |
| `none` | None | No loop of its own; transmits or displays state. |
